author: cellish
body:
IGN: cellish 
Discord( Name#): cellish#4803
Timezone: GMT +1
Any previous Ref experience? Not really, but I know how to games work and I'm experienced in competitive minecraft.
Why would you like to join the referee team: I guess I want to first become a ref, then I think you get promoted from Ref to Official. So becoming an Official is my goal. I want to help Avicus to become a better server (competitively) and I want to help Avicus with tournaments to make people enjoy them as much as possible. Like right now tournaments have been delayed and shit, which isn't really good. I know I can't do anything about those things as I'm not a developer, but at least I could help making the tournament better and enjoyable!
Are you able to commit to Saturday Tournaments, and occasionally event staff meetings?
I should be as long as it's not too late.
A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself:
My name is Sam, I'm 14 years old and I speak fluent english. I like being with friends, playing football, playing minecraft, drawing, making texture packs, and other stuff. 
Anything else?: accept me
